title: Experiential Agricultural Discovery
desc: Students and visitors gathering amidst lush open farm fields under guided stewardship.

title: Barefoot Paddy Silt Transplantation
desc: Stepping into wetland mud to transplant young heirloom rice seedlings into living soil.

title: Indigenous Livestock & Cattle Interaction
desc: Hands-on cattle care, feeding indigenous cows, and understanding A1 and A2 milk production.

title: Traditional Clay Pottery Wheel
desc: Centering wet clay with village artisans and creating earthen pottery to take home.

title: Walk-in Aviary & Exotic Birds
desc: Observing bird species up close and studying diverse nest-building architectures.

title: Ancestral Dung Cake Making
desc: Learning the science of organic biomass, natural biogas, and traditional drying methods.

title: The Persian Wheel (Rahat)
desc: Operating historical gearing and bucket chains to lift crystal groundwater into field flumes.

title: Open-Air Tractor Joy Ride
desc: Riding across fertile farmland pathways with wind in your hair and panoramic Deccan views.

title: Grass Castle & Hay Trampoline
desc: Safe, exuberant play jumping into clean harvest straw stacks under the open sky.

title: Farmer's Watch Tower Horizon
desc: Climbing the elevated timber vantage tower to survey crop boundaries and granite hills.

title: Outdoor Soil Science Classroom
desc: Educators and agricultural instructors explaining microbial soil ecology to school groups.

title: Vintage Bullock Cart Journey
desc: A rhythmic wooden cart ride honoring centuries of rural Indian transport traditions.

title: Sensory Organic Vegetable Picking
desc: Harvesting fresh seasonal vegetables directly from organic beds and learning soil health.

title: Traditional Stone Chakki Grain Grinding
desc: Turning the heavy granite millstone to grind whole wheat and millets into fresh flour.

title: Straw Scarecrow Workshop
desc: Creating traditional crop guardians with straw frames, painted clay pots, and discarded shirts.

title: Archimedes Screw Water Physics
desc: Turning the helical spiral pump to witness ancient mechanical water displacement in action.

title: Student Creations & Memories
desc: School students proudly displaying handmade clay pots crafted during their field trip.

title: Folk Music, Dance & Village Celebration
desc: Rhythmic Telangana folk beats, group dance, and celebratory laughter at the farm pavilion.

title: Rainwater Harvesting & Ground Recharge
desc: Demonstrating natural percolation layers and aquifer recharge models for conservation.

title: Deccan Countryside Golden Hour
desc: Evening light filtering over granite boulders and tranquil organic Telangana agricultural fields.
